title: Toy not shared or taken away
false_belief_text: I have to react when things feel unfair.
true_belief_text: I can pause and choose my response.

title: Screen time cut off suddenly
false_belief_text: I have to get what I want immediately.
true_belief_text: I can handle disappointment and make wise choices.

title: Told 'no' without explanation
false_belief_text: If people say "no", they don't care about me.
true_belief_text: I can listen, ask and understand even when I don't like the answer.

title: Sibling gets bigger portion or more attention
false_belief_text: Someone else's success makes me less important.
true_belief_text: Everyone has their own gifts and my worth doesn't depend on comparison.

title: Can't finish homework or a craft
false_belief_text: If I can't do it quickly, I can't do it.
true_belief_text: Every attempt helps me improve.

title: Playdate or plan suddenly cancelled
false_belief_text: Plans must happen my way.
true_belief_text: I can adapt and still enjoy life.

title: Someone breaks their Lego or drawing
false_belief_text: My anger should decide what I do.
true_belief_text: I can choose calm actions even when I'm upset.

title: Being hurried to put shoes on or leave
false_belief_text: Everything has to happen right now.
true_belief_text: I can slow down and work with the moment I'm in.

title: Feeling hungry or extremely tired (hangry)
false_belief_text: I can't cope when my body feels uncomfortable.
true_belief_text: I can care for my body and uncomfortable moments will pass.

title: Blamed for something they didn't do
false_belief_text: Being blamed means nobody believes me.
true_belief_text: I can respond honestly and calmly, even when things feel unfair.

title: Being teased or physically pushed
false_belief_text: If someone hurts me, I should hurt them back.
true_belief_text: I can protect myself without losing control.

title: No say in what to wear or eat
false_belief_text: I should always get to decide everything.
true_belief_text: I can cooperate even when I don't get my way.

title: Adult doesn't understand what they mean
false_belief_text: If people don't understand me, something is wrong with me.
true_belief_text: I can express myself patiently and be myself.

title: Game crashes or internet lags during a win
false_belief_text: One setback ruins everything.
true_belief_text: I can begin again after setbacks.

title: Forced to sit still too long (car, flight)
false_belief_text: I can't stay calm when I feel trapped.
true_belief_text: I can find peaceful ways to handle uncomfortable moments.

title: Game save file corrupted or deleted
false_belief_text: Losing my progress means I've failed.
true_belief_text: I can rebuild and keep moving forward.

title: A treat or promise was forgotten
false_belief_text: Broken promises mean people don't care about me.
true_belief_text: Trust grows through honesty, reliability and understanding.

title: Sibling tells on them unfairly
false_belief_text: I have to get even when something feels unfair.
true_belief_text: I can respond with honesty instead of revenge.

title: Scratchy clothes or irritating noise
false_belief_text: I can't be okay when things feel uncomfortable.
true_belief_text: I can stay peaceful even when my surroundings aren't perfect.

title: Repeatedly failing a level or concept
false_belief_text: If I keep failing, I should quit.
true_belief_text: Every challenge helps me become stronger.

title: Darkness or shadows in the room
false_belief_text: Fear means I should stop.
true_belief_text: Courage is taking one small brave step.

title: Thunder, fireworks, or loud sirens
false_belief_text: Loud or unexpected things mean I'm not safe.
true_belief_text: I can find safety, calm and support.

title: Monsters under the bed or scary stories
false_belief_text: My imagination can control me.
true_belief_text: I can be braver than my fears.

title: Parent leaving for work or a long trip
false_belief_text: When someone leaves, they might not come back.
true_belief_text: I can trust the people who love and care for me.

title: Fear of going on stage or presenting
false_belief_text: If I'm nervous, I can't do it.
true_belief_text: Confidence grows each time I try.

title: Anxiety before a big test or result
false_belief_text: If I don't do well, I'm not good enough.
true_belief_text: My effort and learning matter more than perfect results.

title: Injections, doctors, or dentist visits
false_belief_text: If something hurts, I can't handle it.
true_belief_text: I am stronger than I think, even during difficult moments.

title: New teacher or unfamiliar adult
false_belief_text: New people won't understand or help me.
true_belief_text: Trust grows one step at a time.

title: Fear of getting lost in a mall or crowd
false_belief_text: If I'm alone, I'm not safe.
true_belief_text: I can stay calm, make wise choices and find help.

title: Accidentally saw a scary or violent video
false_belief_text: The scary things I see will happen to me.
true_belief_text: I can separate imagination from reality and seek comfort.

title: Heard about war or violence on news
false_belief_text: The world is always dangerous.
true_belief_text: There are many people working every day to keep others safe.

title: Saw news about floods, fires, earthquakes
false_belief_text: Bad things mean everything is ruined forever.
true_belief_text: People can help, rebuild and begin again.

title: Fear that a parent might get sick
false_belief_text: I might lose the people I love.
true_belief_text: Love, care and support help us through uncertain times.

title: Overheard adults talking about money problems
false_belief_text: We won't be okay if money is tight.
true_belief_text: Families work together and find solutions during hard times.

title: Overthinking imaginary future dangers
false_belief_text: I have to believe every scary thought.
true_belief_text: Thoughts are not always facts, and I can return to the present.

title: Fear of being laughed at by class
false_belief_text: If others laugh at me, I don't matter.
true_belief_text: My value isn't decided by other people's opinions.

title: First day at a new school
false_belief_text: I won't fit in here.
true_belief_text: I can make connections while being myself.

title: Fear of dogs, spiders, or insects
false_belief_text: Fear means I should avoid everything unfamiliar.
true_belief_text: I can learn, stay safe and become braver step by step.

title: Fear of falling or getting hurt at park
false_belief_text: If I fall once, I shouldn't try again.
true_belief_text: Trying again helps me grow stronger and more confident.

title: Fear of getting in trouble with teacher
false_belief_text: Making mistakes makes me a bad child.
true_belief_text: Honesty and responsibility are more important than being perfect.

title: Anxiety about the earth breaking (climate change)
false_belief_text: Nothing I do can make a difference.
true_belief_text: Small caring actions can help create a better future.

title: Friend is not playing with them today
false_belief_text: If my friend chooses someone else, I'm not important.
true_belief_text: Friendships can grow even when people spend time with others.

title: Death of a pet
false_belief_text: Love disappears when someone is gone.
true_belief_text: Love stays with us through our memories and kindness.

title: Death of a relative or family member
false_belief_text: Life will never feel happy again.
true_belief_text: Love continues through memories, family and hope.

title: Lost a favourite toy or comfort blanket
false_belief_text: I can't be okay without this special thing.
true_belief_text: The love and comfort I feel live inside me too.

title: Harshly reprimanded by a parent
false_belief_text: When I make mistakes, I'm not loved.
true_belief_text: I can make mistakes and still be deeply loved.

title: Feeling invisible to a busy parent
false_belief_text: I'm not important because nobody notices me.
true_belief_text: I matter even when people are busy.

title: Not invited to a birthday party
false_belief_text: Being left out means nobody likes me.
true_belief_text: One invitation does not decide my worth or my friendships.

title: A fall or scrape — the shock of pain
false_belief_text: Getting hurt means I should stop trying.
true_belief_text: I can heal, recover and keep growing.

title: Missing a parent who travels often
false_belief_text: Distance means love becomes smaller.
true_belief_text: Love stays strong even when people are far away.

title: Close friend moved to another city
false_belief_text: If someone leaves, our friendship is over.
true_belief_text: Real friendships can continue across distance and time.

title: Moving house and leaving familiar bedroom
false_belief_text: Everything familiar is gone forever.
true_belief_text: Home is built through love, memories and new beginnings.

title: Long illness, lockdown recovery, school break
false_belief_text: Life will never feel normal again.
true_belief_text: I can adapt and create new routines after change.

title: Highly anticipated movie or event cancelled
false_belief_text: If plans change, everything is ruined.
true_belief_text: New opportunities can grow from unexpected changes.

title: Seeing another child or animal cry or suffer
false_belief_text: Their pain has nothing to do with me.
true_belief_text: Caring actions can comfort others and make a difference.

title: Excluded from a group chat
false_belief_text: Being left out means I don't matter.
true_belief_text: One group doesn't decide my value or my friendships.

title: Not chosen for a special school role
false_belief_text: If I'm not chosen, I'm not good enough.
true_belief_text: My worth isn't decided by awards or roles.

title: Last day of summer vacation / school year end
false_belief_text: Good things are over forever.
true_belief_text: Every ending also brings a new beginning.

title: Looking at photos when they were 'little'
false_belief_text: I've lost who I used to be.
true_belief_text: Growing changes me, but I'm still me inside.

title: Intentions were good but they got in trouble anyway
false_belief_text: Good intentions don't matter if I make mistakes.
true_belief_text: Honest intentions and taking responsibility both matter.

title: Made a mistake in front of the class
false_belief_text: One mistake means I'm not capable.
true_belief_text: Mistakes are part of learning and growing.

title: Forgot someone's name or a social cue
false_belief_text: If I forget, people won't like me.
true_belief_text: Everyone makes mistakes, and kindness repairs them.

title: Called 'fat' or 'chubby' by a peer
false_belief_text: My appearance decides my value.
true_belief_text: My worth comes from who I am, not how I look.

title: New glasses and feeling 'nerdy' or 'ugly'
false_belief_text: Looking different makes me less lovable.
true_belief_text: The things that make me different are part of who I am.

title: Getting acne or pimples (older kids)
false_belief_text: I have to look perfect to be accepted.
true_belief_text: My appearance doesn't define my value.

title: Being shortest or tallest in the class line
false_belief_text: Being different makes me less important.
true_belief_text: Everyone grows in their own unique way.

title: Being 'slower' at reading or math than others
false_belief_text: If I learn slowly, I'm not smart.
true_belief_text: Everyone learns at their own pace.

title: Picked last for a team or called 'clumsy'
false_belief_text: I'm not good enough to belong.
true_belief_text: Skills improve with practice and effort.

title: Their clothes aren't as 'cool' as others'
false_belief_text: I need nicer things to be accepted.
true_belief_text: Who I am matters more than what I own.

title: Thinking 'I can't do anything right'
false_belief_text: I fail at everything.
true_belief_text: I have many strengths and can keep improving.

title: Sibling praised while they were ignored
false_belief_text: Love has to be earned by being the best.
true_belief_text: I am loved for who I am, not because I outperform others.

title: Project or video gets no likes or views
false_belief_text: If people don't notice me, I don't matter.
true_belief_text: My work has value even without applause.

title: Drawing doesn't look how they imagined
false_belief_text: If it isn't perfect, I should stop.
true_belief_text: Improvement comes through practice, not perfection.

title: Reprimanded in front of friends or guests
false_belief_text: Public mistakes make me less worthy.
true_belief_text: One embarrassing moment doesn't change my worth.

title: Stuttered or forgot lines in a play
false_belief_text: If I mess up, everyone will remember forever.
true_belief_text: Courage is continuing even after mistakes.

title: Told their work is 'messy' or unreadable
false_belief_text: If my work isn't perfect, I'm not capable.
true_belief_text: Skills improve with practice and feedback.

title: Why can't you be more like [cousin/friend]?
false_belief_text: I have to be like someone else to be valued.
true_belief_text: My unique strengths make me valuable.

title: Feeling like a burden to parents
false_belief_text: I make life harder for everyone.
true_belief_text: I am loved because I am part of the family, not because I'm perfect.

title: Feeling like they're not seen or valued
false_belief_text: Nobody notices or values me.
true_belief_text: I matter even when others are busy or distracted.

title: Secretly thinking 'I am just a bad kid'
false_belief_text: I am a bad person because I make mistakes.
true_belief_text: I make mistakes, but I am still a good person who can grow.

title: Parent praises sibling's work but not theirs
false_belief_text: Praise decides my value.
true_belief_text: My worth isn't measured by comparison or praise.

title: Best friend is playing with someone else
false_belief_text: I'll be replaced.
true_belief_text: Friendships grow and there's room for many connections.

title: Friend got the newest toy, phone or iPad
false_belief_text: I need what others have to be happy.
true_belief_text: Gratitude brings more joy than comparison.

title: Classmate won Student of the Month
false_belief_text: Someone else's success means I'm not successful.
true_belief_text: I can celebrate others while continuing my own journey.

title: Someone else always gets to go first
false_belief_text: Fair means I should get an equal turn every time.
true_belief_text: Fairness includes patience and considering everyone.

title: Parent on work call when child wants to share something
false_belief_text: If I have to wait, what I want to say isn't important.
true_belief_text: My thoughts matter, and I can wait for the right moment.

title: At a party but wanting the birthday gifts
false_belief_text: I'll only be happy if I get what someone else has.
true_belief_text: Celebrating others can bring joy too.

title: Friend is naturally better at football or dance
false_belief_text: Talent is something you either have or don't.
true_belief_text: Practice helps me improve my own abilities.

title: New sibling gets all the attention and new things
false_belief_text: The new baby has replaced me.
true_belief_text: Love grows; it isn't divided.

title: Another kid always gets teacher's favour
false_belief_text: If someone else is chosen, I'm less important.
true_belief_text: I can focus on my own growth instead of comparison.

title: Friend has more followers or game skins
false_belief_text: Having more things or popularity makes someone better.
true_belief_text: Real happiness and friendship can't be measured by possessions or popularity.

title: Friend went on a fancy international vacation
false_belief_text: Exciting experiences make someone more important.
true_belief_text: Meaningful memories can be created anywhere.

title: Wishing they had someone else's hair or height
false_belief_text: I have to look different to be enough.
true_belief_text: My uniqueness is part of what makes me special.

title: Wanting what's in a friend's lunchbox
false_belief_text: What others have is always better.
true_belief_text: Gratitude helps me enjoy what I already have.

title: Friend has a later bedtime or more freedom
false_belief_text: Different rules mean my parents are unfair.
true_belief_text: Every family makes choices based on different needs.

title: Always wearing older sibling's old clothes
false_belief_text: New things make someone more valuable.
true_belief_text: My value isn't determined by what I own.

title: Post-party or festival hyperactivity
false_belief_text: I have to follow every exciting feeling.
true_belief_text: I can enjoy excitement and still calm my body afterwards.

title: Zoning out after too much YouTube or gaming
false_belief_text: My attention controls me.
true_belief_text: I can guide my attention back to what matters.

title: Noisy, overcrowded mall or festival environment
false_belief_text: I can't cope when everything feels overwhelming.
true_belief_text: I can notice what I need and find calm even in busy places.

title: Too many classes — tuition, sport, music all in one day
false_belief_text: I have to do everything perfectly.
true_belief_text: I can do my best while caring for my energy.

title: Long wait at doctor, bank, or during travel
false_belief_text: Waiting is pointless and unbearable.
true_belief_text: I can use waiting time calmly and wisely.

title: Stuck indoors on a rainy day with nothing to do
false_belief_text: Fun only happens when things go as planned.
true_belief_text: I can create joy wherever I am.

title: End of a long school week — brain feels full
false_belief_text: I should always keep going.
true_belief_text: Rest is part of learning and growing.

title: Cranky after a late night or bad sleep
false_belief_text: Being tired gives me no control over my behaviour.
true_belief_text: I can notice my feelings and choose kind actions.

title: Trying to do homework while TV is on
false_belief_text: I can't focus when there are distractions.
true_belief_text: I can gently bring my attention back.

title: Too many options for a toy or treat
false_belief_text: More choices always make me happier.
true_belief_text: Wise choices matter more than having everything.

title: Pressure to always 'be good' and behave
false_belief_text: I have to be perfect to be loved.
true_belief_text: I am loved even while I'm learning and growing.

title: Waiting for a turn on the swings
false_belief_text: I should always go first.
true_belief_text: Everyone deserves a turn.

title: Switching from fun activity to chores or homework
false_belief_text: I should only do what I enjoy.
true_belief_text: Responsibility helps me earn greater freedom.

title: The 'before dinner' energy crash
false_belief_text: My feelings should decide my behaviour.
true_belief_text: I can care for my feelings without hurting others.

title: Uncomfortable uniform, flickering lights, strong smells
false_belief_text: I can't cope when things feel uncomfortable.
true_belief_text: I can care for myself and ask for help when needed.

title: Waiting very excitedly for birthday or special package
false_belief_text: Waiting ruins the fun.
true_belief_text: Anticipation can make joyful moments even sweeter.

title: Trying to learn a very hard new concept or language
false_belief_text: If I don't understand quickly, I'm not smart.
true_belief_text: Understanding grows with patience and practice.

title: Moving to a new home or city
false_belief_text: I'll never feel at home again.
true_belief_text: Home grows wherever love and connection grow.

title: Moving abroad (very relevant for NRI families)
false_belief_text: I won't belong in a new country.
true_belief_text: I can build new friendships while keeping my roots.

title: Parents separating or getting a divorce
false_belief_text: My family is broken and I'm not safe anymore.
true_belief_text: Love and security can continue even when families change.

title: A parent starts a new job with different hours
false_belief_text: Less time together means less love.
true_belief_text: Love isn't measured by time but by care and connection.

title: Starting at a completely new school
false_belief_text: Nobody will accept me.
true_belief_text: I can create new friendships by being myself.

title: Favourite teacher changes mid-year
false_belief_text: Good things never last.
true_belief_text: New people can also become trusted guides.

title: Sudden cancellation of a normal routine event
false_belief_text: Everything has to happen the way I expected.
true_belief_text: I can adapt and discover new possibilities.

title: Summer ending and school starting again
false_belief_text: Fun is over now.
true_belief_text: Every new season brings new adventures.

title: Growing pains, first tooth loss, puberty signs
false_belief_text: Growing and changing is scary.
true_belief_text: Growing is a natural and wonderful part of life.

title: Friend suddenly acting different or 'cooler'
false_belief_text: I have to change to keep my friends.
true_belief_text: Real friendships accept me for who I am.

title: Game or app changes interface completely
false_belief_text: I don't like change, so I can't enjoy it.
true_belief_text: I can learn new ways of doing things.

title: New nanny or household helper joins family
false_belief_text: New people can't become part of my safe world.
true_belief_text: Trust grows through kindness and shared experiences.

title: News of an upcoming surgery or treatment
false_belief_text: I won't be able to handle what's coming.
true_belief_text: I can face difficult moments one brave step at a time.

title: Family having to cut back on treats or outings
false_belief_text: Happiness comes from having more.
true_belief_text: Love, togetherness and gratitude bring lasting happiness.

title: Waiting anxiously for exam results
false_belief_text: My marks decide my value.
true_belief_text: My effort and character matter more than any score.

title: First time staying overnight away from home
false_belief_text: I can't feel safe away from home.
true_belief_text: I can feel safe in new places with trusted people.

title: Stopping a favourite hobby or activity
false_belief_text: If one chapter ends, all the joy is gone.
true_belief_text: New interests and opportunities will come.

title: Overheard adults talk about 'a big change coming'
false_belief_text: Unknown changes are always bad.
true_belief_text: I can face change calmly and ask questions when I'm unsure.

title: Told a lie to a parent and feels a 'heavy' stomach
false_belief_text: Hiding the truth will protect me.
true_belief_text: Honesty brings trust, even after mistakes.

title: Friends asked them to steal or break a rule
false_belief_text: I must follow my friends to belong.
true_belief_text: Doing what's right is more important than fitting in.

title: Watched someone get bullied and did nothing
false_belief_text: Speaking up won't make a difference.
true_belief_text: Small acts of courage can protect others.

title: A mean kid got praised or rewarded
false_belief_text: Bad behaviour always wins.
true_belief_text: I can't control others, but I can choose my own values.

title: Wants to play but knows they should study
false_belief_text: I should always do what feels fun now.
true_belief_text: Choosing responsibility today helps me tomorrow.

title: Tempted to look at friend's paper during a test
false_belief_text: Cheating is okay if it helps me succeed.
true_belief_text: Honest effort builds real confidence.

title: Told a 'bad' secret they feel should be shared
false_belief_text: Keeping every secret makes me a good friend.
true_belief_text: Safe adults should know secrets that can protect someone.

title: Broke something by mistake and hid it
false_belief_text: Hiding mistakes makes them disappear.
true_belief_text: Taking responsibility helps rebuild trust.

title: Realised some kids don't have food or shoes
false_belief_text: Other people's struggles have nothing to do with me.
true_belief_text: Kindness and generosity can make a real difference.

title: Saw a parent or teacher break a rule they enforce
false_belief_text: Rules only matter when they're convenient.
true_belief_text: I can choose integrity regardless of what others do.

title: Someone online asked for their personal password
false_belief_text: Everyone online can be trusted.
true_belief_text: I protect myself by making safe choices and asking trusted adults.

title: Saw someone litter and felt upset but said nothing
false_belief_text: One person's actions don't matter.
true_belief_text: Small responsible actions help care for our world.

title: Saw a stray animal being treated badly
false_belief_text: It's not my place to help.
true_belief_text: Every living being deserves kindness and care.

title: Failed to keep a promise they made to a friend
false_belief_text: One broken promise means the friendship is ruined.
true_belief_text: Trust can be rebuilt through honesty and consistent actions.

title: Feels guilty for not including someone in play
false_belief_text: There's only room for some people.
true_belief_text: Everyone deserves a chance to belong.

title: Friend said something mean about their culture or family
false_belief_text: I should hide who I am to fit in.
true_belief_text: My identity deserves respect, and I can respect others too.

title: Found something and doesn't know whether to keep it
false_belief_text: If I found it, it belongs to me.
true_belief_text: Doing the right thing matters more than getting something extra.

title: Overheard talk about politics, protests, or injustice
false_belief_text: The world is only unfair and nothing can change.
true_belief_text: Fairness grows through understanding, courage and responsible action.

title: Best friend makes a new best friend
false_belief_text: If my friend likes someone else, I'll be forgotten.
true_belief_text: Friendships can grow without replacing each other.

title: Friends don't reply to messages
false_belief_text: No reply means they don't care about me.
true_belief_text: I shouldn't assume the worst before I know the truth.

title: Accidentally left out of a game
false_belief_text: Being left out means I don't belong.
true_belief_text: I can help create spaces where everyone belongs.

title: A secret wasn't shared with them
false_belief_text: If I'm not told everything, I'm not important.
true_belief_text: Trust grows through honesty, not knowing every secret.

title: Friend copies their work or idea
false_belief_text: If someone copies me, I've lost what makes me special.
true_belief_text: My ideas and creativity remain valuable.

title: A friend wins while they lose
false_belief_text: Someone else's success makes me less successful.
true_belief_text: I can celebrate others while continuing my own journey.

title: Friend breaks a promise
false_belief_text: Once trust is broken, it can never be repaired.
true_belief_text: Honest conversations and actions can rebuild trust.

title: Rumours or gossip spread about them
false_belief_text: I have to prove myself to everyone.
true_belief_text: Truth and character matter more than rumours.

title: Friend apologises after hurting them
false_belief_text: Holding on to hurt keeps me safe.
true_belief_text: Forgiveness helps relationships heal and grow.

title: They hurt a friend's feelings by mistake
false_belief_text: One mistake makes me a bad friend.
true_belief_text: I can apologise, repair and learn from my mistakes.

title: Asked to choose between two friends
false_belief_text: I have to choose one person over another.
true_belief_text: I can be kind and fair to everyone.

title: Lost during a team game because of their mistake
false_belief_text: Everyone will blame me forever.
true_belief_text: Mistakes are part of teamwork and learning.

title: Teammate isn't doing their part
false_belief_text: I have to control others for things to go well.
true_belief_text: Cooperation grows through patience and communication.

title: Friend gets a pet they always wanted
false_belief_text: Life is unfair because I don't have what they have.
true_belief_text: I can be genuinely happy for others while appreciating my own life.

title: A younger child wants to join the game
false_belief_text: Younger children will spoil our fun.
true_belief_text: Everyone deserves a chance to belong.

title: Friend is nervous before a performance
false_belief_text: It's not my job to help.
true_belief_text: Encouragement can help someone become brave.

title: Classmate is new and sitting alone
false_belief_text: Someone else will help them.
true_belief_text: Small acts of kindness can make someone feel welcome.

title: Friend keeps interrupting while talking
false_belief_text: The loudest person should be heard.
true_belief_text: Listening is an important way to show respect.

title: Group project where everyone has different ideas
false_belief_text: My idea has to be chosen.
true_belief_text: Great ideas grow when people work together.
